SCT_CityRegion.name: The City
SCT_CityRegion.text: Contemporary dense city of apartments, sidewalks, trains, cafés, rehearsal rooms and night spaces. Inhabited, practical and human-scale rather than iconic.

SCT_InnerRegion.name: Pattern Space
SCT_InnerRegion.text: Subjective theatrical plane built from graphite grids, handwritten equations, circuitry, margins, constellations and recursive movement.

SCT_CommunityRegion.name: Community Space
SCT_CommunityRegion.text: Human-scale communal rooms for music and movement, using chairs, simple instruments, found percussion, open floor area and practical daylight.
